title: Veggie Egg Casserole Tray
seoTitle: Veggie Egg Casserole Tray | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Baked egg casserole with spinach, bell pepper, and feta for eight
subtitle: Baked egg casserole with spinach, bell pepper, and feta for eight
description: Eggs whisk with milk and bake in a deep tray with spinach, bell pepper, onion, and feta into a sliceable morning casserole for the whole crew.

steps.title: Preheat and sauté vegetables
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 375°F. Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil 6 minutes until softened. Add garlic and spinach, cook 2 minutes until wilted and dry.

steps.title: Whisk egg base
steps.instruction: Whisk eggs, milk, flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper until smooth with no flour lumps visible at the bottom of the bowl.

steps.title: Combine filling
steps.instruction: Fold sautéed vegetables and feta into egg mixture until evenly distributed with vegetables suspended throughout, not sunk to bottom.

steps.title: Bake casserole
steps.instruction: Pour into greased deep hotel pan. Bake 32–38 minutes until center is set, puffed, and knife inserted in middle comes out clean.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.instruction: Rest 10 minutes. Cut into 12 squares. Texture should be firm and springy, not wet or rubbery in the center.

proTips: Add turkey sausage crumbles for extra protein without changing bake time much.
Reheat squares covered with foil at 325°F for 15 minutes.
Hot sauce at the line wakes up mild morning palates.
leftovers: Casserole squares in breakfast burritos with salsa.
Freeze individually wrapped for backup shift breakfasts.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Grab a square and go. High protein start without frying eggs to order during a busy turnover.
mealPrepNotes: Bake night before and reheat morning of. Cut into 12 squares for easy portions. Station: Use a 4-inch deep hotel pan for even bake and clean slicing. Station: Squeeze spinach dry—excess moisture makes a soggy casserole center. Station: Rest pan 10 minutes before cutting so squares hold their shape.
